note: XVII cue 25 redrawn (Ian, 16 Nov): Mina at the study door hearing Seward dictate.
style: A dark, intimate oil painting of 1893 in the manner of the reference: academic realism, deep chiaroscuro, warm lamp light against brown-black shadow, rich glazes. One single painting filling the whole 16:9 frame, no text, signature, border or black bars.

people.mina: Mina Harker, a young dark-haired Englishwoman of about twenty-five, hair pinned up, a plain dark dress with a white high collar; no mark on her face
people.seward: Dr John Seward, a doctor of about thirty, dark hair, bare clean-shaven face with no beard and no moustache, dark frock coat

beats.text: Seen from a dim hallway of the asylum: the young woman has paused just outside a half-open study door, one hand on the door frame, her head turned to listen. Through the gap, warm lamplight: the doctor sits alone at his desk speaking into the speaking-tube of an Edison phonograph with a wax cylinder, no one else in the room. Dark panelled hall in the foreground, the lit room beyond.
